Sample.SAMPLE START: Sets playback start point (0-100%) between the sample's start and end markers.
Sample.INTERPOLATION MODE: Transposition quality: Lo-fi, Standard, or Best.
Sample.ALLOW STREAMING: Streams the sample from disk when program streaming is enabled; otherwise plays from memory.

MultiSample.INTERPOLATION: Transposition quality: Lo-fi, Standard, or Best.
MultiSample.ROUND ROBIN: Take selection when zones share a span: First, Cycle, or Random.
MultiSample.MODE: Layer playback: Velocity, Continuous, or Velocity XFade.
MultiSample.MORPH: Position on the velocity layer ladder (+/-100%); can be modulated per voice.
MultiSample.RANGE: Limits how far down the layer ladder Morph reaches (0-100%).
MultiSample.CURVE: Shapes how quickly Morph travels the layers (0.25-4).
MultiSample.VEL GAIN RANGE: Level difference between softest and hardest velocity (0-90 dB).
MultiSample.KEY TRK: Adds velocity dynamic range per octave above middle C (+/-6 dB).

Slice.SIGNATURE: Time signature of the loop: 2/4, 3/4, 4/4, 5/4, 6/8, or 7/8.
Slice.TEMPO FACTOR: Coarse playback speed: /4, /2, x1, x2, or x4.
Slice.MODE: Slice source: Imported slices from the file or User markers.
Slice.SENSITIVITY: Auto-detects slices with User markers; higher values create more slices (0-1).
Slice.SYNC: Playback sync: position, tempo, or off.
Slice.START: First slice played when triggered; zero is the first slice.
Slice.SPEED: Playback tempo adjustment, up to 50% faster or slower.
Slice.AMOUNT: Slice extension amount when playing slower than original tempo (0-200%).
Slice.ATTACK: Envelope attack time per slice (0-100 ms).
Slice.HOLD: Envelope hold time per slice (0-2 s).
Slice.DECAY: Envelope decay time per slice (0.01-2 s).

Spectral Stretch.START: Playback start position in the sample (0-100%).
Spectral Stretch.SPEED: Playback speed without pitch change (0-4x); freezes below 0.01x.
Spectral Stretch.SYNC: Speed mode: Off, Ratio (11 musical ratios), or Tempo.
Spectral Stretch.TEMPO: Sample's own tempo (0-300); 0 uses the file's metadata tempo.
Spectral Stretch.GRAIN: Analysis window length (40-200 ms); short follows attacks, long resolves tones.
Spectral Stretch.STEREO: Stereo phase handling: Off, Mid, Left, Loudest, or PCA.
Spectral Stretch.PHASE: Phase carry-over method: Classic, Loose, Locked, Locked Soft, Coherent, Coherent Diffuse, or Coherent Full.
Spectral Stretch.TRANSIENT: Attack handling: Off, Reset, or Hold.
Spectral Stretch.THRESH: Spectral movement needed to count as an attack (0-100%).
Spectral Stretch.PER BIN: Applies transient handling per frequency band instead of the whole spectrum.

Stretch.SAMPLE START: Playback start point (0-100%) between the sample's markers.
Stretch.LEGATO MODE: Retriggered notes continue from the current position at the new pitch.
Stretch.TEMPO: Sample base tempo (0-300); 0 means not set.
Stretch.SYNC: Syncs playback speed to Falcon's tempo.
Stretch.SOLO MODE: Switches between monophonic and polyphonic pitch-shifting algorithms.

Grains.SCHEDULING MODE: Classic (periodic), Cloud (random), or Pitch (pitch-periodic) grain spacing.
Grains.LINK: Links loop start to the transport position.
Grains.LOOP: Play head at loop end: None, Fwd, or Fwd-Bwd.
Grains.POSITION: Central read point for grain generation (0-100%).
Grains.SPEED: Speed the position marker moves through the sample (0-10).
Grains.SIZE: Grain duration in Classic and Cloud modes (0.002-2 s).
Grains.FORMANT: Shifts timbre without changing pitch in Pitch mode (-12 to 12 st).
Grains.PERIOD: Time between the starts of successive grains (0.001-2 s).
Grains.PITCH CORRECTION: Compensates transposition using None, Grain size, or Period.
Grains.ENVELOPE MODE: Grain window: Parametric, Triangle, Hanning, Welch, or Squared.
Grains.JITTER: Random timing variation of grain triggers (0-100%).
Grains.PITCH: Random pitch deviation per grain (0-12 semitones).
Grains.SKIP: Probability a scheduled grain is skipped (0-100%).
Grains.SPREAD: Spreads unison voice playback positions around Position (0-10 s).
Grains.DETUNE: Pitch difference between unison voices (0-50 cents).
Grains.PAN: Stereo width of grains and voices (0-100%).

IRCAM Granular.DENSITY: Number of overlapping grains; 1.00 is standard playback (0.1-10).
IRCAM Granular.FADE: Portion of the grain affected by envelope fades (0-100%).
IRCAM Granular.SYMMETRY: Balances grain envelope attack and decay (0-100%).
IRCAM Granular.WINDOW: Grain envelope shape: Triangle, Hanning, Welch, or Squared.
IRCAM Granular.PITCH VARIATION: Random pitch variation per grain (0-1200 cents).
IRCAM Granular.PITCH CORRECTION: Compensation method: Grain Size or Period.
IRCAM Granular.POSITION: Playback start point as a percentage of the marked region (0-100%).
IRCAM Granular.POSITION VARIATION: Random offset around the current position (0-500 ms).
IRCAM Granular.LOOP MODE: Loop handling: None, Forward, or Forward-Backward.

IRCAM Multi Granular.POSITION SPREAD: Random variation of each voice's start position (0-10,000 ms).
IRCAM Multi Granular.DETUNE: Symmetric pitch spread of unison voices around the note (0-50 cents).
IRCAM Multi Granular.REVERSE: Plays individual grains in reverse, independent of Direction.
IRCAM Multi Granular.SIZE: Grain duration (5-500 ms), as in IRCAM Granular.
IRCAM Multi Granular.DENSITY: Overlapping grain count (0.1-10), as in IRCAM Granular.

IRCAM Scrub.PADDING: Frequency oversampling: x1, x2, or x4.
IRCAM Scrub.SHAPE: Shape preservation option for monophonic sounds.

IRCAM Stretch.SPEED: Playback rate factor (0-10, default 1.00); clamped to 0.001x at minimum.
IRCAM Stretch.START: Playback start point (0-100%) between the sample's markers.
IRCAM Stretch.WINDOW: Analysis window length (40-200 ms, default 92 ms).
IRCAM Stretch.PADDING: Frequency oversampling: x1, x2, or x4 (default x1).
IRCAM Stretch.TRANSIENTS: Transient preservation for rhythmic or percussive material.
IRCAM Stretch.ENVELOPE: Envelope preservation to avoid unwanted pitch artifacts.
IRCAM Stretch.SHAPE: Preserves the character of voices and monophonic sounds.
IRCAM Stretch.LEGATO: New voices start at the playback position of currently playing voices.

8o8 Bass Drum.MODE: Kick for short variable decay with true trigger, or Bass for longer fixed decay.
8o8 Bass Drum.TRANSIENT: Attack character: Soft, Normal, or Punchy.
8o8 Bass Drum.TONE: Adjusts the high end of the sound (0-100%).
8o8 Bass Drum.DECAY: Decay amount (0-100%); available in Kick mode only.
8o8 Bass Drum.TRUE TRIGGER: Enables true trigger; available in Kick mode only.

Additive.STRETCH: Inharmonicity of partials, like stiff strings (0-100%).
Additive.DISSONANCE: Disturbs the harmonic series; 100% is harmonic (0-800%).
Additive.QUANTIZE DISSONANCE: Snaps Dissonance to simple ratios of 25% or 16.67%.
Additive.FREQ. SHIFT: Shifts all partials by a fixed Hz amount (0-20,000 Hz).
Additive.EVEN/ODD: Balances even and odd harmonic levels (+/-100%).
Additive.HARM. SHIFT: Shifts spectrum up to +48 semitones while keeping harmonic relation.
Additive.FREQUENCY: Relative frequency of the comb filter on the harmonics (0-100%).
Additive.Q: Filter resonance (0.5-100), available for resonant types.
Additive.TYPE: Filter type: LP-BW, BP-BW, HP-BW, LP-Res, BP-Res, or HP-Res.
Additive.BEATING: Fixed Hz shift of partials creating amplitude beating (0-10 Hz).
Additive.DETUNE: Detuning of each unison voice (0-40 cents).
Additive.KEEP BASS: Preserves the fundamental as a reference while processing the spectrum.
Additive.RAMP TIME: Ramp time between amplitude changes (0-1000 ms).
Additive.START PHASE: Phase at which partials start on note-on (0-100%).

Analog.WAVEFORM: Waveform shape: saw, square, triangle, sine, noise, or pulse.
Analog.PWM: Pulse width for square and shifts symmetry of other shapes (1-99%).
Analog.START PHASE: Point in the waveform where playback begins (0-100%).
Analog.SYNC: Hard-syncs voices to a hidden control oscillator.
Analog.SHIFT: Drift amount from the sync control oscillator (0-36 semitones; up to 72 with modulation).
Analog.STEREO: Toggles mono or stereo; stops sounding notes when changed.
Analog.PHASE SPREAD: Voice phase spread style: Uniform, Exponential, or Random.
Analog.STEREO SPREAD: Amount of stereo spread (0-100%); style is Uniform or Hard.
Analog.DETUNE: Pitch detune per voice (0-100%); style is Standard or Large.

Analog Stack.ENABLE/DISABLE: Turns each of the eight oscillators on or off.
Analog Stack.POLARITY: Reverses the waveform polarity for each oscillator.
Analog Stack.GAIN: Level of each oscillator (-inf to 0 dB).
Analog Stack.OCT: Octave transposition for each oscillator (-2 to 2).
Analog Stack.SEMI: Semitone transposition for each oscillator (-12 to 12).
Analog Stack.CENT: Fine detune for each oscillator (+/-100 cents).
Analog Stack.PITCH: Audio transposition offset in semitones; modulation range +/-48.

Bowed String.FORCE: How hard the bow pushes the string (0-2 N).
Bowed String.VEL>V: Velocity modulation amount for bow speed (0-100%).
Bowed String.DYN. FRICTION: Friction factor of the bowing action (0-50%).
Bowed String.HYSTERESIS: Adds stick-slip friction memory for a grainier attack.
Bowed String.INSTRUMENT: Instrument type: Violin, Viola, or Cello.
Bowed String.STRING: String choice: Highest, High, Low, or Lowest.
Bowed String.MODE: Articulation: Constant, Sautille, Fast Martele, Staccato, Tremolo, Detache, Accentue, Bouncing, or Manual.
Bowed String.STROKE FREQUENCY: Stroke speed for stroke-based articulations (0.1-10 Hz).
Bowed String.DECAY: Body decay time of low frequencies (0.1-1000 s).

Drum.WAVEFORM SHAPE: Pitched oscillator shape: sine, triangle, saw, or pulse.
Drum.FREQUENCY: Base pitch of the pitched oscillator (20-20,000 Hz).
Drum.RATE: Speed of pitch modulation; readout depends on Shape.
Drum.SHAPE: Pitch modulation shape: exponential, sine, or noise.
Drum.FILTER: Noise filter type: low-pass, band-pass, or high-pass.
Drum.DECAY STYLE: Noise decay curve: exponential or linear.
Drum.VEL SENS: Velocity sensitivity for O, P, and N destinations (0-100%).

FM.RATIO: Operator frequency relative to base frequency (1-40).
FM.HZ: Switches the operator to explicit Hz frequency.
FM.FINE: Fine tuning of the operator ratio (+/-1200 cents).
FM.LEVEL: Output level of each operator (0-20); sets modulation index on B, C, and D.
FM.TOPOLOGY: Routing arrangement among the four operators.
FM.SNAP: Locks ratios to harmonic intervals; disabled in Hz mode.

FM Explorer.MORPH: Sweeps routing from series B-C-A through parallel to series C-B-A (+/-100%).
FM Explorer.SHAPE: Modulator waveform from sine at 0% to saw at 100% (0-100%).
FM Explorer.PUNCH: Adds a decaying FM burst and aligns start phases at note-on (0-100%).
FM Explorer.WARP: Crossfades operator B or C across three whole-number ratios (0-100%).
FM Explorer.SHIFT: Detunes the operator against the played pitch (+/-1200 cents).
FM Explorer.FEEDBACK: Feeds the operator back into itself, moving toward noise (0-100%).
FM Explorer.DEPTH: FM index for all modulation paths; main brightness control (0-100%).
FM Explorer.BALANCE: Level of the two modulators in the output (0-100%).
FM Explorer.RING MOD: Ring modulation between the two modulators (0-100%).

Harmonic Resonators.CUTOFF: One-knob low-pass or high-pass filter for noise; Off at center.
Harmonic Resonators.TILT EQ: Low or high shelf tilt (-6 to 6 dB).
Harmonic Resonators.HOLD: Amp envelope hold (0-10 s, or Until Released).
Harmonic Resonators.COARSE: Resonator band frequency in semitones (-24 to 24).
Harmonic Resonators.COUPLING: Band coupling in Reflect and RotCirc modes (0-100%).
Harmonic Resonators.SCALE: How much each band's decay follows its tuning (0-100%).
Harmonic Resonators.DAMPING: High frequency damping of each band (0-100%).
Harmonic Resonators.MIX: Balance of raw exciters versus resonator output (0-100%).
Harmonic Resonators.COUPLING MODE: Band relationship: Parallel, Reflect, or RotCirc.

Noise.NOISE TYPES: Grid of 15 noise types, including Band, SampleAndHold, Static I and II, Crackle, Logistic, Dust, Velvet, and colored noises.
Noise.VALUE: Single control whose label and function change with the selected noise type (0-100%).
Noise.STEREO: Switches mono or stereo with independent left and right noise; stops sounding notes.

Organ.HARMONIC: Pipe size of the percussive harmonic (16' to 1').
Organ.FAST: Percussion decay: 300 ms when enabled, 630 ms when not.

Phase Shaper.FUZZ: Adds fuzz distortion to the waveform (0-100%).
Phase Shaper.INFLEXION: Period of phase ripple, from fine wobbles to a broad bend (0-100%).
Phase Shaper.DEPTH: How strongly the ripple bends the phase (0-100%).

Pluck.MIXER: Levels of SAMPLE, SYNTH, and NOISE excitation sources (-inf to 0 dB).
Pluck.KEYFOLLOW: How much the played key transposes the sample (0-100%).
Pluck.INTERPOLATION MODE: Sample playback quality: Lo-fi, Standard, or Best.
Pluck.PICK FILTER: Enables a pick simulation in the string excitation.
Pluck.PICK POSITION: Position of the pick along the string (0.02-0.5).
Pluck.SHAPE: Roundness or thinness of Synth and Noise exciters (-1 to 1).
Pluck.ROLLOFF: Low-pass filter on excitation sources (20-20,000 Hz).
Pluck.DYNAMICS: Range of velocity-based high frequency attenuation (0-30 dB).
Pluck.EXCITATION BRIGHTNESS: Shortens the Synth exciter pulse to brighten the attack (0-100%).
Pluck.SUSTAIN: Injects noise continuously while the note is held.
Pluck.HARMONIC RATIO: Pitch ratio of the played harmonic relative to the fundamental.
Pluck.COUPLING MODE: Two-string interaction: Serial, Bridge, Beating, or Inharmonic.
Pluck.COUPLING: Amount interpreted according to the coupling mode (0-100%).
Pluck.INHARMONICITY: Stretch of string partials from the harmonic series (0-99.99%).
Pluck.BRIGHTNESS: High frequency shelf for the decay (0-100%).
Pluck.DECAY CUTOFF: Low-pass cutoff for the decay (20-20,000 Hz).
Pluck.DECAY TYPE: String damping filter: LP1, MA, MA2, or Shelf.
Pluck.BRIDGE LOSS: Extra high frequency damping per string cycle; unavailable with MA.

SupraSaw.AIRY: Lets aliasing fold back for a grainier, brighter top end.
SupraSaw.MODE: Pitch configuration: Normal, Center -12, Center -24, Octave +12, Octave +24, Fifth, and combined entries.
SupraSaw.BLEND: Balance of center and side oscillators (0-100%).
SupraSaw.DETUNE: Pitch interval spread of the oscillators (0-100 cents).
SupraSaw.KEYTRACK: Scales detuning with the played pitch.

Texture.MODE: Per-slot playback direction: Forward, Forward Looped, Backward, or Backward Looped.
Texture.LEGATO: Resumes new notes from the currently reached playback position.
Texture.WIDTH: Stereo width of the mix output (0-200%).
Texture.SAMPLE START: Playback start within the marked region (0-100%).
Texture.BANDWIDTH: Band-pass narrowness; narrows as the value rises (0-100%).
Texture.PEAK GAIN: Boost or cut at the peak frequency (-20 to 20 dB).

VOSIM.FORMANT: Formant base frequency in Formant mode (20-4,000 Hz).
VOSIM.RESONANCE: Formant resonance amount in Formant mode (0-100%).
VOSIM.VOWEL: Phonem mode vowel: AA, AE, AO, AW, AX, AY, EH, ER, EY, IY, OW, OY, UH, UX, or Y.
VOSIM.FORMANT SHIFT: Formant frequency shift in semitones (-12 to 12).
VOSIM.MORPH TIME: Transition time when changing vowels while holding a note (0.01-1 s).
VOSIM.MOD. TYPE: Pitch modulation source: Noise or Sine.

Wavetable.WAVE INDEX: Selects the slice within the wavetable (0-100%).
Wavetable.SMOOTHING: Transition smoothing between slices: INDEX or OCTAVES.
Wavetable.ALIASING TOLERANCE: Willingness to use brighter band-limited copies, allowing some aliasing (0-100%).
Wavetable.PHASE DISTORTION MODE: Distortion style: PWM, PWM2+, PWM2, Bend+, Bend-, Bend+-, Formant, SymForm, Fuzzy, or ResoForm.
Wavetable.START PHASE: Point in the cycle where playback begins (0-100%).
Wavetable.FM ENABLE: Turns sine-wave frequency modulation on or off.
Wavetable.FM RATIO: Modulator frequency relative to note pitch (-48 to 48 semitones).
Wavetable.SNAPPING: Ratio quantization: Free, Harmonic, Chromatic, Octaves, Oct + 5th, Fourths, or Fifths.
Wavetable.HZ: Switches the FM ratio to absolute frequency.
Wavetable.WAVE SPREAD: Range of wave index values across unison voices (0-100%).

West Folder.SYMMETRY: Crossfades saw and square core, biases the sine, and sets folding threshold (0-100%).
West Folder.TIMBRE: Drive into the wavefolder, the main source of added harmonics (0-100%).
West Folder.ORDER: Blend between the unfolded core and folded output (0-100%).
West Folder.SHAPE TOGGLE: Feeds the folder with a true sine or a tanh-shaped triangle.
West Folder.ROUND: Rounds the triangle toward a sine; active only with triangle (0-100%).
West Folder.FREQ: Internal modulator rate when free-running (0.1-1000 Hz).
West Folder.WAVE: Modulator shape: Saw, Triangle, or Square.
West Folder.RATIO: Modulator ratio locked to note pitch, from x 1/16 to x 16 (frequency modulation only).
West Folder.MODE: Gate action: Lowpass, VCA, or Both.
West Folder.RESONANCE: Emphasis of the moving filter corner (0-100%); Lowpass mode only.
West Folder.AUTO: Gate opens and closes automatically with the note.
West Folder.GATE: Fixed gate level when Auto is disabled (0-100%).
West Folder.VEL: Scales the automatic gate by note velocity; requires Auto.
West Folder.SENS: Scales the control voltage reaching the vactrol (0-5).
